tool_args.rationale: The acquired high-gradient observations expose the predicted avalanche and, together with the subcritical rows, identify the numerically fitted threshold-siphon model. Fresh confirmation will test its predictive accuracy.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The high-gradient observations fall sharply below the subcritical trend, demonstrating a supercritical loss.
The targeted probe and verified mechanism support a gradient-dependent threshold rather than a function of u_now alone.
The targeted probe has supplied three supercritical observations, giving eight rows for the five-parameter law; an additional trajectory is not needed before confirmation.
